<thought>Based on the spectrum, the dominant isotopic pattern is a pair of peaks at m/z ≈ 199 (M) and m/z ≈ 201 (M+2) with nearly equal intensities (~100 % vs ~98 %). This 1:1 M/M+2 ratio is characteristic of bromine (⁷⁹Br/⁸¹Br). No other element shows a definitive, characteristic pattern (chlorine would give ~1:0.33, sulfur ~4 % M+2, etc.). Therefore, bromine is the only element that can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Br']</final_answer>
